decision.summary: Component-First Implementation specification under DAVE governance strictly binding CommandRail, DecisionCanvas, and EvidencePanel to approved design tokens with zero raw hex codes and zero CLS layout reservations
decision.token_bindings: Strictly bound to code/src/tokens/index.css with zero raw hex values and zero arbitrary spacing brackets
decision.state_matrix: Full deterministic coverage of Empty, Loading, Partial, Full, and Error states per component

assumptions: Target viewport is locked at 1440x900 desktop @ 1.0 DPR with Inter font
Zero expected cumulative layout shift (CLS = 0) via explicit skeleton height reservations
Zero raw hex colors or unapproved spacing values
alternatives_rejected: Ad-hoc freeform implementation without reference citations rejected due to visual drift risks
Inline style hex values rejected due to violation of ADR-005 token guardrails
Unbounded dynamic height skeletons rejected due to layout shift risks
